description: This file implements the ClusterHealthMonitor class responsible for monitoring the health status of silos within an Orleans cluster. It manages the periodic membership updates, silo monitoring, health checks, and lifecycle management of health monitoring components.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitor
classes.description: Monitors the health of silos in an Orleans cluster by tracking membership updates, probing silos, and facilitating health checks and lifecycle events.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitor.ITestAccessor
classes.description: Interface exposing private members of ClusterHealthMonitor for testing purposes.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronously processes membership table updates, manages monitored silos, evicts stale silos, and updates health status accordingly.

methods.name: EvictStaleStateSilos
methods.description: Evicts silos that have exceeded maximum join attempt time or are considered stale based on their status and start time.

methods.name: UpdateMonitoredSilos
methods.description: Determines which silos to monitor based on membership entries, utilizing hash rings for probabilistic expansion, and updates the monitoring list.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the health monitor's lifecycle to start and stop events, including initiating and gracefully stopping monitoring tasks.

methods.name: OnProbeResultInternal
methods.description: Handles the outcome of health probes, suspecting or killing silos based on probe results and configuration.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Performs health checks on monitored silos to determine overall cluster health status.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes resources and stops monitoring silos, cancelling ongoing operations.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes resources, stopping all monitoring tasks and releasing resources.
